judgement.impact: Screen-reader user hears only generic image and misses the 50% OFF TODAY promotion that sighted users see.
User hears 'Total:' with no amount and cannot confirm the final R1,249.00 amount to be paid before paying.
User hears only generic Submit on the payment button and cannot confirm they are paying R1,249 at the moment of payment.
The screen-reader user is not told the card number field is flagged as invalid and cannot know it must be corrected to complete payment.
User hears only generic "Button" and cannot know it pays with wallet or choose that payment option.
The user cannot know the button deletes or clears payment information and will expect it to only close something instead.
The user hears only 'Click here' and cannot tell the link leads to the Terms they must agree to before paying.
